messages:
Noah Kim: Noticed weird line on the March invoice: several preemptible instances in apac-east show 4x the expected hourly multiplier for 2026-03-20 22:00-23:15. Can someone help reconcile?

Sofia Martinez: Which pool/account? I can pull the raw cloud export.

Noah Kim: Mainly pool=preemptible-apac-east, account=acct-mlbench and acct-featurelabs. Totals look inflated on invoice vs internal ledger.

cost-bot: ALERT: Invoice variance detected. Resource=preemptible-apac-east, variance=+312% vs expected calc. Link: https://console.redwood/costs/invoice/variance/2498009999

Ellen Wu: Quick hypothesis: cloud provider applied temporary surge pricing for spot reclaim window last week. We normally normalize invoices with our internal rate table; maybe the normalizer missed these rows.

Sofia Martinez: Pulling raw rows now: SELECT usage_ts, account_id, instance_type, charge_usd, provider_line_item FROM billing_raw WHERE pool='preemptible-apac-east' AND usage_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20 22:00' AND '2026-03-20 23:15';

Noah Kim: Also check whether our normalization function `apply_spot_normalization` was run for that ingest batch. Last deploy changed batch worker to parallel mode on 2026-03-19.

finance-bot: INFO: Billing batch job 2026-03-20-22 failed step `normalize_spot_rates` with error code RATE_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT. Retry attempted. See job: https://billing.redwood/jobs/2026-03-20-22

Sofia Martinez: Found 412 affected rows. provider_line_item shows a surcharge code `SPOT_PREEMPT_SURGE` for multiple instances. charge_usd raw sums to $18,720 but invoice shows $22,480 (difference $3,760).

Ellen Wu: The difference might be due to duplicate credits or double-counting when the normalizer retried. If job retried after partial commit, duplicate normalized rows could be present in billing_flat. Check for duplicate uuid or ingestion_id.

Sofia Martinez: Running dedupe check: SELECT ingestion_id, count(*) FROM billing_flat WHERE ingestion_id IN (SELECT ingestion_id FROM billing_raw WHERE usage_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20 22:00' AND '2026-03-20 23:15') GROUP BY ingestion_id HAVING count(*)>1;

Noah Kim: If duplicates exist, finance needs a clean CSV for retraction: billing_id, account_id, ingestion_id, amount_usd, reason.

finance-bot: SUGGESTION: If duplicate ingestion_id found, tag entries as `retraction_candidate` and pause invoice closing. Ticket FIN-902 created.

Sofia Martinez: Dedupe results: 32 ingestion_ids duplicated across two rows each. Preliminary cause: batch worker parallel-mode race + transactional commit window bug. I exported the candidate retraction CSV to s3://redwood-costs/tmp/preemptible-retractions-2498009999.csv

Ellen Wu: Good find. We should audit which accounts saw the duplicates: looks like acct-mlbench accounts for 78% of the retraction amount.

Noah Kim: OK next steps: 1) finance to hold invoice lines for these rows and mark as pending 2) infra to patch the batch commit to be idempotent 3) run reconciliation and produce corrected invoice delta + memo to customers if impacted.

Sofia Martinez: Infra patch plan (INF-2065): add idempotency token to batch commit and a short backfill job to collapse duplicates. I'll open PR and schedule rollout during a low-impact window. ETA 36h for patch + backfill.

finance-bot: REMINDER: Approval required from @Ellen Wu for invoice hold and from @Noah Kim for customer memo draft.

Ellen Wu: Approved to place hold and prepare internal memo. Noah, please draft a short note to impacted internal stakeholders and external account owners. Keep it neutral and offer reconciliation report.

Noah Kim: Drafting: "We detected duplicate billing lines affecting preemptible usage on 2026-03-20 22:00-23:15 due to a transient ingestion bug. We're holding the affected invoice lines, performing a recharge/retraction process, and will publish a corrected invoice and reconciliation report within 48 hours. No action required unless you see unexpected charges after the correction."

Sofia Martinez: After backfill, I'll run full reconciliation: compare invoice vs normalized ledger and produce `reconciliation_delta.csv`.

Ellen Wu: Also add a short automation: alert when invoice_delta > $1,000 for preemptible pools, since these are high variance. Put that on #finance-alerts.

finance-bot: ACTION: Created alert policy `invoice_delta_preemptible` threshold $1000 -> notify #finance-alerts and page @oncall-finance during business hours.

Noah Kim: Thank you. Let's reconvene after the patch dry-run. Sofia, link to the s3 export and PR in this thread when ready.

Sofia Martinez: Uploaded CSV and created INF-2065 PR. Links: s3://redwood-costs/tmp/preemptible-retractions-2498009999.csv, https://infra.redwood/pr/INF-2065

finance-bot: FOLLOW-UP: check scheduled +48h for FIN-902 and INF-2065."
